lead_raw_text:
The structure of MgSi₂ (Mg₄Si₈ per cell, 12 atoms, reduced formula MgSi₂) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4₁/acd (No. 143), with three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Mg centers with eight Si neighbors and two Si environments: one with five Si neighbors (four Mg, one Si) and another with seven Si neighbors (three Mg, four Si). The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 12 sites. Validated polyhedron contacts indicate corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Si-centered 5-vertex polyhedra, while Mg-centered 8-vertex polyhedra share corners and edges.
